name: Half-High Elf
desc: Humans with high elf blood: keen-eyed in the dark and born with a spark of arcane talent.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: High Elf Darkvision
traits.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: High Elf Magic
traits.desc: You know one Wizard cantrip of your choice. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Arcane Heritage
traits.desc: You always have Detect Magic prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.
